subject: How to make the user input column text be shown as selectInput choices

messages.author: da636f3145353d83
messages.subject: How to make the user input column text be shown as selectInput choices
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have the below code, but the object M is one of the column in the user input file,
I would like to make the selectInput() contains choices from each unique levels of M (e.g from a to j).
the unique M levels are all characters.
--- But Somehow shiny displays that Input option as numeric numbers (e.g from 1 to 10), instead of characters.

Does anyone have any inputs?

Thanks,
Mao

server.R

   ### Inputdata1() is the reactive object contains the user input data
   
  output$Male<-renderUI({
    myData<-Inputdata1()
    M<- unique(myData$Male)
    selectInput('Male',label = strong("Choose your Male") ,choices = M)
  })
